Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Hollow Knight: Silksong, save slot 1 'MOSS GROTTO' (~3+ min play). Reload spawns Hornet in a green mossy hub cavern. HUD last seen: 4 masks, ~4-5 pips, short silk bar, 20/400 shards.

CONTROLS (labels partly unreliable): Z jump; X needle attack; C listed Sprint/Dash (NO visible effect tested); A Bind/heal (crouch+needle raise, white glow; mask count rose 1->3-4 without a bench, so Bind likely heals); arrows walk; Up = face/interact/cling; Down+X down-strike. Escape = pause menu (Continue/Options/Quit; avoid Quit YES). Options: Game/Audio/Video/Controller/Keyboard/Back. Keyboard list text seen: Z Jump, X Attack, C Sprint, A Bind, I Inventory, M Map, Q Crest, Tab Quick Map, S Harpoon, D Needolin, F Skill/Tool, V Challenge, J Journal, T Tasks. WARNING: I, D, T, J all opened Inventory in tests; M and Tab did nothing (no map owned); S, F, Up+S did nothing. Inventory shows only Hunter's Cloak + one crest; most listed abilities NOT acquired.

KEY MECHANICS (OBSERVED):
- Wall-cling/climb: braided/twisted vine columns and coarse shell-stone mosaic/lattice walls ARE clingable with Up+dir+Z and give real height. Plain cluster-stone/cobble walls do not (cap y~0.28-0.30, no ledge).
- Climb is INTERMITTENT: one confirmed chain on the shell-stone lattice beside the tapered posts gained real height (camera pan y~0.49 -> ~0.37); repeated identical inputs later stalled or fell back to the bank (camera pull-back = fall signal).
- Jump-off-and-re-cling laddering (Left+Z off a cling, then Up+Right+Z) gained height once above the pink coral; inconsistent, needs repetition. Alternating jump directions not yet tried as a ladder.
- Moss-draped arch slope west of the banded-stone bank IS clingable (clung at ~y0.42) but cling was not sustained.
- Tapered dark posts are standable footholds. Big black mushroom caps are standable/landable; small caps untested. Mushroom cap on its tall stalk sits right of the sphere (~0.62-0.72, y~0.44-0.47); mounting it not yet achieved.
- Pink coral (~0.775,0.37) on the shell-stone lattice in the dark chamber: NOT breakable by Up+X; never landed on; bounce UNPROVEN.
- Woven iron lattice 'sphere' (snail with curly horn finial + visible eye, wooden stake at lower-left base, black mushroom stalk in front) is ONE landmark and the hub centerpiece. All long walks return to it => the Moss Grotto accessible area forms a CLOSED RING (hub floor + tiled walkway; west waterfall grotto with mossy terraces, light shafts, braided vine columns, pale stone slab above; lower floor under the waterfall looping back to the sphere; east green-lit lush cavern with ferns, tiled path, waterfalls, man-made tiled walkway at y~0.64 looping back; dark unlit chamber east of hub behind a hanging moss curtain with rubble bank, banded pot-stones, tapered posts, shell-stone lattice wall, green glow dots).
- Sphere is INERT: Up, A, X taps (white crescent flash only), Up+X, Down+X at face/stake/peg, pogo, dome-top vertical jump all do nothing.
- Banded oval stones/pots on rubble banks are inert scenery (needle strike = flash only).
- White circular ring prompt icon at the tapered posts (~0.72-0.745,0.44-0.46): Up/A/X and S produced NOTHING; guessed to be a future grapple/Needolin anchor requiring an unowned ability.
- Green glow dots widely scattered: probably decorative (guess); dots at the lattice/ceiling top-right (~0.78,0.23; ~0.93,0.03; ~0.74,0.27; one beyond the right wall ~0.975,0.29) noted as possible passage markers; chasing them yielded nothing.
- Bright light column above the sphere: vertical Z from dome gave nothing; unresolved.
- Foreground black mushrooms/vines/kudzu repeatedly occlude Hornet AND the camera may barely pan; a lateral step is required to verify position before judging success/failure. Screen has gone near-black twice (dark room/fade), recovered by walking Right.

FAILED / DO NOT REPEAT: Up/A/X/Down+X at sphere or stake; vertical jump from dome; X into banded stones; Up alone or S at the ring prompt; S/F/Up+S generally; M/Tab; chasing glow dots; C as speed/dash; cluster/cobble wall climbs past ~y0.30; pogo on anything; point-blank Right+Z against the far-right mosaic wall (no pan, no gain) — needs a run-up or a different approach.

LANDMARK/Y-TABLE REACHED (approx): west grotto upper mossy terrace y~0.35; braided vine cling y~0.22-0.27 (tops out below pale slab); lush cavern mossy shelf y~0.37; dark chamber shell-stone wall cling y~0.37-0.28; dark-chamber upper-left mossy overhang ledge y~0.28 (reached via Left+Z from the rubble bank — new high level) which runs left into black with green dots in the void below-left.

ACTIVE GOALS: find the onward route out of Moss Grotto (floor ring likely closed; exit may need an ability/gate or a vertical/gimmick route such as a bounce); find a real bench; land on/bounce off the pink coral; reach the upper-right lattice crest where green dots sit (~0.78,0.23).

UNRESOLVED GUESSES: coral may bounce; ring icon = unowned-ability anchor; glow dots/light shafts may mark hidden passages; pale slab above the far-west braided vine unreached; dark recess under the shell-stone overhang (~0.78,0.30) untested; ceiling-hung mossy columns above the hub's right side untested as climbable; possible ground-level passage past the bank's far right where a green dot shows beyond the wall.

CURRENT SITUATION: Hornet in/at the dark chamber east of the hub, near the pink coral and tapered posts, having just re-issued Up+Right+Z from the bank; screen showed no camera pan, so whether she is clinging or on the ground is UNVERIFIED. Standing rule: verify with a lateral step before concluding; if camera pulls back after a climb attempt she fell.
